degree_match.note: Mean degree on the configuration-model path is an emergent consequence of (tau, d_min) plus erasure - it is NOT a knob and NOT the ER scaling.target_mean_degree. This measured value is what the phase-1/2 ER arm and the phase-6 GIRG arm were matched to. Reproduce with: arch -arm64 python3 scripts/dump_poster_demo_traces.py --calibrate

demo.headline: Heavy-tailed network, no fear
demo.caption: Same 300 banks and the same average number of links - but now a few hubs hold most of them. The same two-bank shock, fear still off, grinds outward through the hubs for 18 rounds and takes 69% of the system. Structure, not fear, is doing this.
